fixes.value: This is a flow chart titled Figure 1 with yes/no decision boxes that end in green boxes reading "No action required" or "Immediate action not required", or red boxes reading "High Priority". The main column of questions runs from "Ground floor flats opening to open air?" through "Does LGA Guide require replacement FD30S doors?", "Does LGA Guide require upgrade of notional FD30 doors?", "Is there a working and maintained fire suppression system in flats?", "Do FEDs open onto a balcony?", "FR ≥ 20 minutes*?", "FR ≤ 15 minutes*?" and "FR>15 minutes but <20 minutes (i.e. FR is 15-20 minutes)", then "≤ 3 storeys", "Double lobby. One lobby ventilated. ≤ 2 flats per lobby.", "Maisonettes with escape on another level" and "Lobbied staircase. One flat per lobby.", ending in High Priority. Side branches ask "FR ≥ 25 minutes*?", "FR ≥ 15minutes*?", "2 directions of escape, all flats?", "FR ≥ 15 minutes*, below 1.1m" and "Simultaneous evacuation?"; a note under the chart reads "Note: LGA Guide see Fire safety in purpose-built blocks of flats (Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government / Home Office)".
